title: Reduce unnecessary schematic re-renders
scope: React renders and wire-path computation in the real schematic canvas; no backend or AI implementation changes.
rootCauses: WireShape had no memo boundary and received a fresh selection callback plus the complete changing wire array.
Endpoint subscriptions consumed all runtime/electrical properties although routing uses only geometry and pins.
Every wiring-preview movement invalidated all wire paths; active bend preview was supplied to unrelated wires.
CanvasMat was described as memoized but was not; WireToolbar subscribed to the entire canvas store.
Memoized PinDot still received a changing full node, rerendering pins on property-only updates.

implementation.change: Memoize grid, toolbar and wires; narrow toolbar subscriptions; reuse selection action; pass bend-preview state only to its wire; cache path geometry.
Use stable endpoint snapshots across property-only updates; invalidate on position, size, rotation, type, pin identity/alias changes, deletion and document replacement.

Group routing peers by the existing unordered endpoint-pair key and reuse arrays while ordered wire IDs match. Smart-router lane offsets depend only on that membership. Own wire data remains current; routing algorithm and full store document remain intact.
Give PinDot stable width/height/type layout data so property-only and position-only updates do not rerender unchanged pin shapes.
Subscribe to live endpoint properties inside hovered voltage tooltips. Readings continue refreshing without forcing static wire and pin geometry to rerender.

method.fixture: 100 built-in resistors, 99 auto wires, 10 columns, 120x100 world-pixel spacing, scale 0.65. Actual CircuitCanvas with external HTTP blocked; routing finishes before measurements.
method.counters: Test-only Vite transforms count actual component function entries and getWireRenderPoints calls; no production render-counter code was added.
method.drag: 30 native pointer moves; input capture to last Konva layer draw completion. This measures a paint proxy, not physical display scanout.
method.baseline: Original pre-UI-015 files preserved before implementation in local ignored cache, with SHA-256 hashes. Final baseline reruns use those files, not current code.
method.timingLimit: Single-machine measurements vary with host load. Do not attribute the entire change from the earlier UI-014 drag run to UI-015: fresh pre-UI-015 measurements already meet 50 ms p95.

existingDragRegression.note: Historical failure remains in UI-014 evidence; this fresh full command passes all 9 checks, including current-flow, read-only, unmount and one-gesture undo/redo.

acceptance.criterion: Stable wires, pins, grid and toolbar avoid unrelated selection, property and preview updates
acceptance.evidence: 6 action counter comparisons in both development and production; one wire selection 99 to 1 renders, two preview moves 198 to 0.

acceptance.criterion: Reactive geometry, lane membership and interactions remain correct
checks: Unchanged, runtime and electrical-property-only updates retain endpoint geometry identity
Movement, rotation, resize, type and pin coordinate/alias changes invalidate geometry
Deletion, missing endpoints, same-ID document replacement and undo/redo cannot reuse stale geometry
Cached endpoints match fresh routing across every routing mode, manual bends and pin-name aliases
Only changed component-pair membership invalidates routing peer identity
Partitioned peers preserve complete-router points for reversed pairs, lanes, modes and reordered documents

acceptance.criterion: Native browser behavior remains correct through memo boundaries
checks: Wire selection updates one wire and leaves the grid, toolbar and unrelated components alone
Runtime and electrical-property updates avoid unrelated wire routing and toolbar renders
Pan and wiring-preview movement do not rerender stable wires or recompute their paths
A wire style edit leaves every unrelated wire and pin unchanged
Dense native drag meets 50 ms p95 with intact gesture completion and viewport
Native wire selection uses the current wire ID after prior selections and edits
Endpoint movement, rotation/resize, retargeting and peer additions preserve the full-router output
Native bend preview updates only its wire, commits correctly and respects read-only mode
Wire hover probe stays live without rerendering wire geometry on runtime updates
Pin hover probe stays live while unrelated pins and wires retain their render state
Toolbar mode/color, theme and read-only guards remain reactive through memo boundaries

acceptance.criterion: Existing scene, drag and routing browser contracts remain intact

remainingWork.detail: Real-account application baseline is captured in VFOPT_X_001_APP_BASELINE.json. Seven follow-ups remain open, beginning with save-revision conflicts; this is not full application acceptance.
Development render fixture still recorded a 112.2 ms maximum and existing drag fixture 79.8 ms maximum despite passing p95. These are not zero-lag guarantees.
Konva still draws the visible scene during drag. Reduced React/path work does not eliminate raster draw cost or establish a 16.7 ms frame budget, total laptop CPU/GPU or browser memory reduction.
Hovered voltage tooltips refresh on endpoint-node publication as before. Updating only the global voltage map without a publication is not a new guaranteed refresh path.
